_comment: Documents/evidence library. Phase 7. A single DocumentVersions row can be linked from many DocumentEvidenceLinks rows (one approved fire-safety certificate can support several controls across several frameworks at once) — this many-to-many shape is what powers the document detail page's 'Supports N records across M frameworks' summary via computeEvidenceReuseSummary() in functions/shared/pure/evidence-reuse.ts. Expiry is evaluated live from expiry_date against the current date every time a link is used as evidence (isValidEvidence() in document-rules.ts) — never cached as a stored boolean that could go stale.

columns.comment: policy | procedure | risk_assessment | statutory_certificate | training_record | inspection_report | other
Nullable — some documents (group-wide policy) aren't property-scoped.

tables.comment: One row per uploaded version — a new version supersedes the previous rather than overwriting it, so evidence links to an older version stay auditable.

columns.comment: draft | pending_approval | approved | rejected | superseded — validated against isValidDocumentStatusTransition().

tables.comment: The approval DECISION as its own record, mirroring the CAPAVerification/IncidentInvestigation split — who approved/rejected, when, and why, independent of the status column on DocumentVersions.

Many-to-many: one approved DocumentVersion can support many linked entities (control_assessment, capa, audit_finding, climate_risk) and one linked entity can cite many documents. This is the table computeEvidenceReuseSummary() reads to produce 'Supports N records across M frameworks'.
